logic: The QR symbol of each SPAYD text of payment/spayd.json, under the same case name, as GET /api/donations/payment-qr and GeneratePaymentQrService encode it (ZXing 3.5.4, level H, ISO-8859-1 hint): error correction, version, mode, ECI header, mask and matrix. The backend encodes each text through ZXing until slice 1.10; the browser's encoder runs every case from 1.3
